family_meta.description: Google Perch v2 multi-taxa classifier with approximately 14,795 species including birds, insects, amphibians, and mammals (scientific names only)
family_meta.author: Google Research

requirements_note: requirements.min_ram_mb is a conservative, high-biased RAM floor: measured peak RSS + 15% where a benchmark exists, else a size-derived estimate biased high (a too-low floor risks OOM; a too-high floor only over-excludes on the smallest devices). Measured values will replace the estimates over time.
naming: legacy names, frozen; new files follow <family>-<upstream>[-<region>]-<variant>-b<build>.<ext>
notes: Regional slices are bit-exact to the full model on the species they keep. The int8-arm files are withdrawn: each such entry carries withdrawn and superseded_by, stays downloadable for existing installs and must not be offered to new ones. They were quantized from the with-DFT graph and run on ONNX Runtime only; use no_dft_fp32 for every backend. Perch confidence is a softmax, so slicing shifts scores; each regional entry carries score_calibration (method softmax-rest-logit), a per-tile constant that puts a slice's scores back on the full model's scale: score = exp(z) / (sum of exp over the kept classes + exp(rest_logit)). A rebuilt tile's model is named perch-v2-<region>-no-dft-fp32-b<build>.onnx, with its labels and indices as perch-v2-<region>-labels-b<build>.txt and perch-v2-<region>-indices-b<build>.txt, next to the files of earlier builds, which stay as published; superseded_by leads from an old file to its replacement, and the entry without it is the current build.

perch-v2-b2.reason: Every regional model now includes the domestic dog, humans and all other domestic, farmed and pet animals, which many regions were missing.
notes: Every regional model now includes humans and the domestic animals: dog, cat, horse, cattle, sheep, goat, pig, chicken, pigeon, and pets and farm animals such as rabbit, donkey, carp, budgerigar, canary, guinea pig and hamster.
Before this build the domestic dog was missing from 18 regional models, including the Nordic one, so barking dogs could not be reported there.
Carp, pig, yak, guinea pig, hamster and humans were missing from all of the earlier regional models, and many of them also lacked cattle, sheep, goat and chicken.

27 regional models also gained wild species that the species limit had cut or whose names were not matched before, 191 additions in all, for example Demoiselle Crane in the western Palearctic and the Himalaya, Peron's Tree Frog in eastern Australia and Northern Bat in the Nordic region.
Regional models grow by 12 to 38 classes and no regional model lost a class.
The score scaling of each regional model was updated for its new class list, so confidence values can differ slightly from the earlier build.
The global model, the sound classes and the Central India model are unchanged.
perch-v2-b2.changes: 43 regional tiles are rebuilt as build 2 of release 2. Only wildlife is selected by region now: every non-wildlife class is in every tile and does not use the species limit. Each tile's calibration constants are fitted again for its new class list. The low-ram selection key is removed because no single template names the live file of every region, the withdrawn int8-arm entries now point at the build 2 file, and regional entries list their class count. The central-india tile keeps its build.

withdrawn.reason: MatMul-only INT8 changes the result too often on real audio: against the fp32 file, top-1 agrees on 82% of 5,560 station windows for the global model and on 75.5% of 94 windows for the nordic tile, which keeps only 71% of the fp32 detections at 0.5 on the same label. It fails the publish gate's int8 floor (at least 95% top-1 agreement where fp32 scores 0.25 or more, at least 90% of fp32 0.5 detections kept, at most 1% int8-only detections). The file stays downloadable for existing installs; use the entry named in superseded_by.
